name: Princess suite — coordinated interior views
prompt:
Create ONE richly detailed architectural REFERENCE SHEET titled INT-R02 — PRINCESS SUITE / COORDINATED INTERIOR VIEWS. Four large views in a 2x2 grid and one small top plan in the lower margin. Only ONE room and ONE bed across all views, not four different room designs. Use the supplied GEN-24 furniture sheet as the material, gold carving and textile style authority. No bedroom is depicted in that source: this ROOM LAYOUT IS PROPOSED. Preserve ivory and rose-veined marble, gilt floral/star tracery, cobalt and blush glass, dusty pink textiles, indigo valances. Furniture remains HUMAN scale: bed mattress 2.0 x 2.2m, table 0.75m high, chairs 0.48m seat height. No human figures.

FIXED PROPOSED PLAN, SAME IN EVERY VIEW: 24m east-west by 18m north-south, ceiling apex 12m. North is top of small plan. Exactly one pink canopy bed on the north wall, headboard north, foot toward south, centre x0,y6.5. Two bedside cabinets. Dressing cupboards and moon mirror form a west/northwest alcove. Exactly THREE tall pointed window bays on EAST wall at y=-5,0,+5; gold mullions, cobalt/rose glass. SOUTH wall has exactly one central double entry door. Southwest corner has the source chaise, one reading chair and tea table. Southeast corner has a memory display console with closed gift boxes and a few framed keepsakes. Repeat none of these as extra furniture in other corners. One chandelier over the centre. Three shallow pointed ceiling bays run north-south with indigo star infill, ivory ribs and gold bosses. Lower cornice at 4.5m; tall clerestory above. Doors and cupboards are reachable by a clear connected aisle at least1.8m wide. No bath, kitchen, music or service facilities.

VIEW A: from just inside SOUTH entry looking NORTH, bed clearly visible, east windows on right, west dressing left. VIEW B: from NORTH near bed foot looking SOUTH, double entry centred, east windows on left, reading and memory zones at far corners. VIEW C: from WEST looking EAST, exactly three east windows across opposite wall, north bed at left, south entry to right. VIEW D: high corner CUTAWAY looking down into the same room, one half of ceiling lifted and underside shown above the room; reveal ceiling ribs, all four walls and circulation. Small top plan labelled N/E/S/W must preserve the fixed counts and positions. Do not mirror the room, add extra doors or multiply beds between views.

Make it feel inhabited and celebratory through REUSABLE dressing, not empty vast floors: layered pink/indigo rugs near each seating/bed zone, rose garlands over door and bed cornice, gilt sconces, bows on two cabinet handles, small floral urns, lanterns, star pennants and neatly grouped gifts/memory objects. Keep eye-level carved wall panels and curtain tiebacks readable. Full height architecture remains visible, furniture is not enlarged to fill it. Neutral ivory sheet background, crisp labels outside art. Label the single room asset INT-R02-S01; view letters are views, not new asset IDs. Footer: Concept reference / proposed layout / view consistency and geometry require review.
